paper_claim: Human adaptation learned from partially labeled multi-source human tasks produces visual and person-semantic representations that improve a matched DINOv3 grounder.
hypothesis: Task-valid multi-source supervision, named pose serialization and person-conditioned Mask2Former decoding will teach Qwen Vision transferable human structure without an external RGB encoder.
falsifier: Close or revise the branch if generated Human Slot ownership fails, if dense losses do not causally reach Qwen Vision, or if adapted frozen Qwen features do not beat base-Qwen features in matched DINO transfer.

data_contract.unit: image record with deterministic person slots, scene entities and relation edges
data_contract.missing_labels: explicit valid=false; never converted to negatives
data_contract.pose: COCO-17 and MHP-16 map by joint name to a 21-joint union; MHP visibility 0/1/2 is converted to canonical COCO-style 2/1/0
data_contract.segment: COCO binary person mask remains distinct from MHP parsing
data_contract.relations: person subject and object endpoint identity are preserved
data_contract.cross_dataset_join: exact source identifiers first; otherwise mutual-best IoU above a fixed threshold and ambiguity margin; rejected matches remain unmerged
data_contract.split_policy: global image identity audit prevents COCO/VG/PSG overlap across train and evaluation

representation.human_slot: one generated <human> token per deterministic person record
representation.text_tasks: box, named 21-joint pose coordinates, age, gender, attributes and relations
representation.segment: <human> state plus segment task embedding conditions a Mask2Former person query
representation.parsing: <human> state plus 58 part embeddings condition Mask2Former part queries
representation.owner_binding: one person assignment is shared by every task

necessary_adaptation: equal-grid Qwen intermediate features are converted to P4/P8/P16/P32
learned Mask2Former queries are replaced by person-owned LLM query content
binary segment and MHP part queries share the dense decoder

training.sampling: choose task first, then dataset proportional to sqrt(eligible records); retain controlled joint packets
training.parameter_scope: Vision all-block LoRA, full merger, LLM attention/MLP LoRA, special rows, bridge and dense decoder

losses.text: autoregressive cross-entropy on present task fields only

evaluation.mhp_parsing: official mIoU, APp50, APpvol and PCP50
evaluation.psg_relation: official R@K and mR@K with person-relation subset
evaluation.aggregation_rule: never average incompatible scorers or units into one AP

V5_G1_COCO_SMALL_GENERATED.requirement: free-generation Human Slot and dense geometry learnability on a small frozen set

V5_G2_COCO_FULL.requirement: COCO-UniHuman official evaluation plus base/adapted frozen probes

V5_G3_MULTISOURCE.requirement: native per-dataset official evaluation and matched transfer controls

controls: DINO plus frozen base-Qwen visual features
DINO plus frozen v5-Qwen visual features
v5 visual transfer plus frozen semantic states

cost.gpu: no new GPU run authorized or queued
cost.storage_blocker: MHP, PSG and VAW assets do not fit the current free-space budget without a storage decision

reopen_condition: Official source assets, annotation decoders, split de-duplication and scorer parity must pass before multi-source training.
